sentences.en: The cathedral had a religious painting on its ceiling.
sentences.zh: 那座大教堂的天花板上有一幅宗教画。

sentences.en: There was a beautiful chandelier hanging from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 天花板上悬挂着一个漂亮的吊灯。

sentences.en: Down came the ceiling and the dog went away.
sentences.zh: 天花板塌了下来，狗也跑了。

senses.zh: 天花板，顶棚最高限度，上限高度，上升限度；云幕高度形容词:ceilinged
